title: lycianthes acutangula
intro: Lycianthes acutangula, commonly known as the Chinese Box or Chinese Box Hedge, is a type of flowering plant native to Asia. This plant is known for its edible fruits and leaves, which are rich in nutrients and possess several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycianthes acutangula include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
